Supreme Court Hears Plea on Delhi Voter List Deletions

The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a petition filed by opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, concerning the deletion of names from the Delhi voter list. The petitioners have raised questions about names being removed and allege pressure to fill Form-6 to get them reinstated. The hearing was set for October 28, according to one report, while another indicated October 15.
